in_marathi.name: Dhuni
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of oblations
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhuni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhuni refers to the sacred fire used in Hindu rituals. It represents purification, sacrifice, and offerings to the gods. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhuni', meaning 'heap of embers'.
